requirements.text: Validation tests are performed on out-of-sample and, where available, out-of-time samples, with observation window, sample definition and exclusions documented for each test.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §4.1.

requirements.text: Each red test result leads to a finding of at least Medium severity, and a red calibration result for a regulatory-capital model is assessed for High severity.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §4.2.

requirements.text: AUC and Gini are computed on the validation sample with a 95% confidence interval, using the DeLong method or a bootstrap with at least 1,000 replications.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §5.1.

requirements.text: The Gini coefficient meets the absolute thresholds per model type; red applies below 0.50 for retail behavioural PD, below 0.35 for retail application and SME PD, and below 0.45 for corporate PD.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to PD and credit scoring models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §5.2.

requirements.text: The current AUC is compared with the AUC at initial validation or last recalibration; a relative Gini decrease above 10% or a significant decrease is amber, above 20% red.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §5.3.

requirements.text: Observed default rates increase monotonically with the rating grade, and a statistically significant inversion between adjacent grades is rated amber.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to PD-calibrated credit rating and scoring models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §5.4.

requirements.text: For LGD and CCF models the generalised AUC or Somers' D is computed and compared with the development value using the relative-decrease thresholds of §5.3.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to LGD and CCF models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §5.5.

requirements.text: Representativeness is tested on default-rate levels, not only on risk-driver distributions.
requirements.verification_note: Pilot requirement VAL-04 kept verbatim; anchored in MV-HB-003 §6.1(b) and specified in §6.3.

requirements.text: Risk-driver and score distributions of the development sample and the current portfolio are compared using the PSI per risk driver, complemented by a comparison of missing and special-value shares.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §6.2.

requirements.text: The default-rate comparison uses a two-sample test of proportions per segment and grade at 5% significance; a significant difference is amber and a significant difference above 20% relative is red.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §6.3.

requirements.text: Qualitative representativeness is assessed for segmentation, product mix, underwriting standards, collection and recovery policies, economic conditions and legal environment.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §6.4.

requirements.text: Material non-representativeness leads to a finding and to an assessment of whether recalibration or a margin of conservatism under CRM-STD-101 is required.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §6.5.

requirements.text: For each grade an exact one-sided binomial test is performed of the grade PD against underestimation of the observed default rate, with amber at p < 5% and red at p < 1%.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to PD-calibrated credit rating and scoring models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §7.1.

requirements.text: The Jeffreys test (Beta(D + ½, N − D + ½) posterior) is performed per grade and at portfolio level, with amber at p < 5% and red at p < 1%.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to PD-calibrated credit rating and scoring models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §7.2.

requirements.text: The Hosmer–Lemeshow test is applied across all grades on the out-of-time sample, and a red result is corroborated by per-grade tests before a finding is raised.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to PD-calibrated credit rating and scoring models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §7.3.

requirements.text: For IRB PD models the long-run average default rate is compared with the portfolio-average PD; a relative deviation above 10% is amber and above 20% red.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to IRB PD models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §7.5.

requirements.text: For IFRS 9 and other models requiring unbiased estimates, calibration tests are applied two-sided and overestimation is treated as underestimation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §7.6.

requirements.text: The PSI is computed on the score or grade distribution and on each risk driver, using at least ten buckets or the rating grades, with empty buckets floored at 0.01%.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §8.1.

requirements.text: A PSI below 0.10 is rated green, from 0.10 to below 0.25 amber, and 0.25 or above red.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §8.2.

requirements.text: The twelve-month rating migration matrix is analysed; a share of obligors migrating by more than two grades above 10% is amber and above 20% red.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to PD-calibrated credit rating and scoring models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §8.3.

requirements.text: Realised LGDs are compared with estimated LGDs per segment for closed recovery processes using a one-sided t-test on the mean difference, with amber at p < 5% and red at p < 1%.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §9.1.

requirements.text: Downturn LGD estimates are not lower than the realised LGDs observed in the identified downturn period.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §9.3.

requirements.text: ELBE is compared with realised LGDs for defaulted exposures, and LGD in-default is not lower than ELBE for any exposure.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to LGD models for defaulted exposures only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §9.4.

requirements.text: Realised CCFs measured with a fixed twelve-month horizon are compared with estimated CCFs per facility type using a one-sided t-test, with amber at p < 5% and red at p < 1%.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §10.1.

requirements.text: The EAD coverage ratio (estimated over realised EAD) is green at 1.00 or above, amber from 0.90 to below 1.00, and red below 0.90.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §10.2.

requirements.text: Performance on training, test and out-of-time samples is compared; a Gini difference between training and out-of-time sample above 5 percentage points is amber and above 10 red.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §11.1.

requirements.text: The model is re-trained with at least five random seeds and perturbed hyperparameters, and a Gini standard deviation above 2 percentage points is amber.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §11.2.

requirements.text: The model is compared with an interpretable challenger on the same data, and a Gini uplift below 3 percentage points is amber and requires justification of the added complexity.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §11.3.

requirements.text: Feature importances are compared between development and out-of-time samples, and a Spearman rank correlation below 0.7 for the top 20 features is amber.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §11.4.

requirements.text: All tests are reported in an annex to the validation report stating sample, test statistic, threshold and traffic-light result, and tests not performed are listed with the reason.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard authored by Model Validation; provision MV-HB-003 §12.1.
